Retrieve the Institutional Visits Register

Source: R/datasets.R
senace_visitas.Rd

Downloads records of visits to SENACE offices or retrieves their bundled local snapshot.

Usage

senace_visitas(api_key = NULL, offline = FALSE)

Arguments

api_key

A SENACE API key. If NULL, it is retrieved automatically.

offline

If TRUE, use the dataset bundled with the package instead of querying the API.

Value

A tibble.

Examples

senace_visitas(offline = TRUE)
